The Army made Eugene a man. But Daisy gave him basic training!

Pierre (la femme du chef des Cheveux Propres)

Antonio Rodríguez, el hermano mayor de José Luis

Lorenzo Giammaresi  il papà di Arturo
Maria Pia,  la madre di Arturo

The lucky ones got their brains blown out!!
